The '''Sentry Droid''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] piloted by a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] and used by [[Bandin Dobah]] to guard his [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base|asteroid base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It took 20 [[Standard minute/Legends|standard minutes]] to orbit around the base and was programmed to attack any unauthorized intruder.
